title: Private mooring licence
summary: This page provides information and links for managing a private mooring licence, including applying, renewing, changing details, and transferring ownership.

Withdraw a priority waiting list application (private)

faqs.q: How do I apply for a private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a private mooring licence using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: What if I need to renew or replace my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence or replace it through the relevant online services.

faqs.q: How can I change details on my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can change your address and contact details, or apply to change the vessel or relocate the licence.

faqs.q: Can I transfer or cancel my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: Yes, you can transfer ownership of the licence or cancel it, or withdraw a priority waiting list application.
